name: Gmail
description: Search, read and draft replies in Gmail from any session, through your Google account. It never sends.

connections.why: Searches and reads your mail and writes draft replies. It never sends.

launch.label: From a Gmail thread…
launch.description: Your Gmail, in the columns you choose. The session starts knowing the whole thread: every message, and every attachment saved to disk.

settings.label: Columns
settings.description: Gmail searches, as Name=Gmail search pairs separated by ;

settings.label: Check for new mail every (seconds)
settings.description: For a poller to come: nothing checks for new mail yet.

settings.label: Google account
settings.description: The email of the connected account to use; empty means the first connected Google account.
